rows.text: Holding a syringe containing Metabolase, you stride toward the putrefied throne slowly and nervously... All it takes is a tiny dose deliver into the Swarm's fibers and... You pierce it with the needle!
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The dose wakes the Lord of Eternal Slumber up! It opens its eyes wide and starts drooling...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: You know metabolism takes time... and you want to witness its completion! However, more and more Swarm larvae are coming! You must escape from them quickly...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
